# Near-anchor band regression vectors for `cosh` (fd-aqs.6).
# Unary line: <prec> <mode> <input> <correctly-rounded-output>.
# Binary line (pow): <prec> <mode> <input1> <input2> <output>.
# Oracle: mpmath @160dps with a 1e-60 boundary-margin guard;
# ln/log10/pow additionally cross-checked against libmpdec at
# every emitted mode. Directed-mode lines appear only where a
# 50-digit-correct kernel can decide them (off-grid at 50
# digits); grid-exact cases are NearestEven/NearestAway-only
# pending the fd-aqs.7 enclosure seam. Mathematical fact, not
# copyrightable expression.
# Regenerate: tools/gen_anchor_band_vectors.py
